purpose: Prepare explicit engine selection, identity isolation, host observations and inference connectivity without exposing remote placement or changing resource bindings.

bundle.note: Built before integrating concurrent CI/cache and Fabric test scheduling changes; production SDK/provider sources are identical to the integrated tree.

behavioralEvidence: Two isolated socket fixtures contain same-named resources; selection, observation failures and cleanup remain on the requested engine.
A fixed injected connection set rejects missing and duplicate entries without a local fallback.
Same-daemon access recovery preserves storage identity; alias retarget and mismatched injected endpoints fail before mutation.
Capacity accepts complete typed observations from the selected daemon; missing, incomplete or wrong-target measurements fail.
Inference resolution preserves external URLs and credential references independently of sandbox placement and performs no reachability probe during plan.
A failed sandbox inference probe retains established state; subsequent successful apply has no resource changes or credential leakage.
Three read-only live Docker tests preserved the original deployment runtime and retained storage bindings.

podman.blocker: sudo requires an interactive password; no system packages changed
findings: Pinned gateway includes a native Podman driver using image volumes and secrets.
Native client requests the v5.0.0 API; compatibility with the Ubuntu candidate remains untested.
pending: Native rootless/rootful version and namespace identity evidence
Sandbox start, policy enforcement, inference route, actual agent response, deletion

limits: Fixture engines are isolated HTTP daemons, not live Docker or Podman engines.
No engineRef YAML, remote transport, TLS credential rotation implementation or migration operation was added.
Default capacity collection remains the existing local Linux topology; injected remote observers must supply their own measurements.
SDK in-process connection/observer injection does not cross OpenTofu subprocess boundaries.
Managed local inference still publishes at its Docker bridge address; a fixture unreachable endpoint is not remote network qualification.
Refresh/export retain osquery; immediate version checks, mutations, active probes, local credentials/state and resident memory checks remain direct.
